sources.title: Saraswathy Amjith - saraamjith.com
sources.snippet: A self-questioning framework that trains a VLM to decompose compositional visual questions into sub-questions using GRPO, without any reasoning demonstrations. Applied to a 3B-parameter model on CLEVR and A-OKVQA, both self-questioning and standard RL substantially improve accuracy over the untrained model.
